Name: Fix Immersive Farm 2 Map For NPC Map Location
Author: tigerne
Description:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7213]Vibrant Pastoral Recolor[/url]Fix Immersive Farm 2 Map For NPC Map Location and Daisy Earthy Recolour.
Now your position at farm on the map is correct. It shows your real position.
Show with English. If you have [color=#616161][b][color=#ff0000][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5255]DaisyNiko's Earthy Recolour[/url]﻿[/color][/b][/color][b] [/b][b], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7213]Vibrant Pastoral Recolor[/url][/b]then the map will auto change to that recolour. Or it will be the vanilla map.
Put it in Content/Mods, and if you have another Recolour mod for immersive farm 2, send it too me and i can add it.
The translation file are in the i18n folder, if you want to translate it, tell me and add a new json.
Required mod:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher (CP)[/url]﻿
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]﻿
Stardew Valley Expand (SVE)[/url]﻿
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/239]NPC Map Location[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/239]

[/url]Old:[img]https://tva1.sinaimg.cn/large/a74abce7gy1h3ejsuyix1j21hc0u01ky.jpg[/img]

New:[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/12587/12587-1655740195-439848821.png[/img]

修复了SVE的附带地图：沉浸农场2和NPC地图位置不兼容问题，现在小地图可以正常显示了
[color=#ff0000][b]自带汉化[/b][/color]，同时，还增加了Daisy Nico的地图着色，让地图颜色相匹配
直接解压，丢进Content/Mods文件夹即可，[b][color=#ff0000]如果你安装了[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5255]DaisyNiko's Earthy Recolour[/url]﻿ [/color]或[b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7213]Vibrant Pastoral Recolor[/url][/b][color=#ff0000]，地图会自动替换，没安装就是原地图[/color][/b]
如果你有其他的沉浸农场地图着色，也可以发给我，我可以制作替换。如果你想翻译，直接在i18n文件夹里增加对应翻译并告诉我即可
欢迎在百度贴吧的这个贴：[url=http:]我的帖子[/url]直接回复我, [b][color=#ff0000]N网不能直接评论中文！[/color][/b]
